crossRefs.note: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down…
Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to…
“Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them…
“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds,
of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.
But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that…
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…
whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your…
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be…
holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for…
and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any…
For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who…
For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation…
But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand…
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…
For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the…
For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ…
Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of…
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
“I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews…
Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will…

translations.web: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
translations.bsb: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
translations.kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
